name: sistema-fila-sus
description: Monorepo do Sistema de Transparencia de Filas Publicas (SUS) — CESMAC

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const run = (dir) => spawn('npm', ['--prefix', dir, 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const b = run('backend'); const f = run('frontend'); const sair = () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); }; process.on('SIGINT', sair); process.on('SIGTERM', sair);"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
